english.title: Make a false / misleading statement in purported compliance in providing information required by regulations
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in purported compliance with a requirement to provide information imposed by or under the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010, made a statement which you knew to be false or misleading in a material particular or recklessly made a statement which was false or misleading in a material particular, namely **(..SPECIFY FALSE STATEMENT..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 38(4)(b)(i) and 39(3) of the Environmental Permitting (England and Wales) Regulations 2010.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit or Prosecutions:
None.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
